verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਭੇਉ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur chele raharaas alakh abheau hai|

en.bdb: The ways of the Guru and the disciple are mysterious and imperceptible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur chele saabaas naanak dheau hai|

en.bdb: Guru (Nanak) and disciple (Angad) both are blest (because both have merged into each other).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮੇਉ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat sahaj nivaas sifat sameau hai|

en.bdb: Their abode is the wisdom of Guru and they both are rapt in the praises of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat paragaas achhal achheau hai|

en.bdb: Enlightened with the Word their consciousness has become infinite and immutable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਅਰਖੇਉ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh aas niraas mat arakheau hai|

en.bdb: Transcending all hopes they have assimilated subtle wisdom in their person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮੇਉ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaam karodh vinaas sifat sameau hai|

en.bdb: Conquering the lust and anger they have absorbed themselves in the praises (of God).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਉਲਾਸ ਸਕਤਿ ਨ ਸੇਉ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: sat sa(n)tokh ulaas sakat na seau hai|

en.bdb: Beyond the abodes of Siva and Sakti they have reached the abode of truth, contentment and  bliss.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚੇਉ ਹੈ।
verses.translit_en: ghar hee vich udhaas sach sucheau hai|

en.bdb: Being indifferent to household (pleasures) they are truth-oriented.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh abhiaas gur sikh dheau hai ||2||

en.bdb: The Guru and disciple have now attain the ratio of twenty and twenty One, i.e. the disciple has gone ahead of the Guru.
